name: vscode-theme-zellner
description: Port of the classic Zellner Vim color scheme to Visual Studio Code, with light and dark variants
author: Yue Yu

scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce package --baseContentUrl https://github.com/yuyuqp/zellner/blob/main/packages/vscode
scripts.publish:vsce: pnpm run build && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce publish --baseContentUrl https://github.com/yuyuqp/zellner/blob/main/packages/vscode
scripts.publish:ovsx: pnpm run package && pnpm dlx ovsx publish vscode-theme-zellner-0.2.0.vsix
scripts.lint: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); pkg.contributes.themes.forEach(theme => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(theme.path, 'utf8'))); console.log('VS Code extension theme JSON is valid');"
